items.title: BioNTech (BNTX) Enters First Global Phase 3 Trial For New Breast Cancer Combo
items.summary: BioNTech (NasdaqGS:BNTX) and Gilead Sciences announced a clinical trial collaboration to test a novel first-line treatment approach in metastatic triple-negative breast cancer. The partnership centers on BioNTech’s bispecific immunomodulator pumitamig combined with a Gilead antibody-drug conjugate in a global Phase 3 study.
